evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth from ~6 ppm (ramp) to 44.7 ppm, indicating ingress of air
Temperature holds at setpoint with plausible heater power; thermal control appears normal
Pressure gauge not installed, so leak cannot be confirmed by pressure; atmosphere verification incomplete

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure trace (gauge not installed) or a flow/leak-check test: e.g., raise Ar flow or isolate the tube and watch whether O2 falls, to distinguish a real seal leak from O2 sensor drift
